name: Poseidon
description: A Python application leveraging SDN to automatically capture network traffic and classify devices using machine learning. Integrates with FAUCET controller for network visibility and situational awareness.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Poseidon and related components run on top of Docker, orchestrated with docker-compose. Requires version 1.29.2+ with compose file format version 3 and health check conditions.

eval_notes: ML-powered network device classification via SDN. Docker-compose based deployment with FAUCET integration. Good for testing network security and anomaly detection scenarios in SDN environments.
